data.name: Husniah
data.gender_notes: Husniah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Husniah is an indirect Quranic name for girls and boys, derived from the word husn, which means excellence, beauty, and grace. The name Husniah carries the meaning “Excellence, Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Husniah usually hope their child will grow to embody excellence, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To strive for perfection and grace in all aspects of life is the essence of Husniah.
data.etymology: Husniah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellence, Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husniah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Husniah
in_english.meaning: Beautiful and virtuous woman, beautiful soul, good deed, and good character
in_english.long_meaning: Husniah is a name derived from the Arabic root "Hass" which means "beautiful" and "virtuous". In Islamic tradition, the term "Hass" refers to a person of good character and deeds, and is often used to describe a woman of great inner beauty and spiritual strength. The name Husniah is a combination of "Hass" and the feminine suffix "iyah", which emphasizes the feminine qualities of beauty, compassion, and kindness.
